basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast with a particular interest in digital devices and their functionality. I live in the bustling city of Toronto, where I work as a software developer. My love for technology blends seamlessly with my hobby of collecting and experimenting with gadgets. I'm often online in the evenings after work, browsing through Reddit or playing video games. I enjoy engaging in discussions about technology but can sometimes get frustrated with persistent tech issues. I'm currently single, which gives me plenty of time to explore new tech and participate in online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over five years. My expertise comes from a combination of formal education and hands-on experience with various tech projects. I enjoy staying updated with the latest tech trends and often self-teach through online courses and tutorials.
